description: This file defines the PlacementStrategyResolver class responsible for resolving placement strategies for grains in the Orleans runtime. It includes methods for obtaining strategies based on grain types, handling default and custom strategies, and managing internal state for strategy resolution.

classes.name: PlacementStrategyResolver
classes.description: Handles resolution of placement strategies for grains, with caching and fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: PlacementStrategyResolver
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the resolver with dependencies.

methods.name: GetPlacementStrategy
methods.description: Returns the placement strategy for a given grain type, utilizing cache.

methods.name: TryGetNonDefaultPlacementStrategy
methods.description: Attempts to resolve a non-default placement strategy for a grain type.

methods.name: GetPlacementStrategyInternal
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve the placement strategy, returning default if none custom is found.
